content:
alex_k: Heads up — Neptune Labs wants non-standard payment terms for the POC -> production deal. They propose NET90 with a deferred tranche schedule: 30% at POC kick, 40% on pilot success (milestone), 30% at 12mo anniversary. Also asking for a 6mo true-up and an escrow clause for data residency. Can we get deal desk + finance signoff?
maria_s: FYI @raj_dealdesk they pushed pricing up-front to match usage tiers. Sales asking for 15% discount on list in exchange for 3yr commit. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
raj_dealdesk: @maria_s @lisa_finance need clear invoice schedule and SLA tie-ins. Net90 is long — finance needs payment mechanism (ACH vs PO) and risk mitigations (credit check, deposit). Is customer willing to prepay first tranche?
lisa_finance: If they accept 30% initial deposit (prepay) that's easier. Net90 on the rest requires credit approval + Escrow reviewed by legal. We can do conditional: approve net90 for remaining balance if credit score OK and Escrow clause limited to source-code escrow only (no customer data).
emma_se: Quick tech note: POC will run on Dedicated for first 3 months, then we plan a warm handoff to Hosted. Need to pin model versions for compliance. That may change cost tier. Put that in SOW.
alex_k: Customer prefers deposit instead of PO upfront. They said procurement cycle is ~60-90 days; they can sign PO but payment hits Net90. We offered bridge: 30% prepay by card/ACH, remainder on Net90 with milestone invoices.
raj_dealdesk: Drafted a conditional approval template: 
```
- 30% prepay within 10 business days of PO
- 40% invoice on pilot acceptance (invoice Net30) — require acceptance criteria in SOW
- 30% final invoice at 12 months (invoice Net90) with 6mo true-up clause
- Escrow limited to source-code and configuration only; HSM/KMS remain with customer
- 15% discount honored across committed 3yr ARR if they sign 3yr MSA
```
raj_dealdesk: @lisa_finance we need your explicit: can finance accept "mixed terms" (some Net30, one Net90) and still recognize revenue properly? Also any limits on longest receivable allowed?
lisa_finance: Mixed invoice terms ok but Net90 must be escrowed in AR policy and requires Credit Hold + internal signoff for deals > $250k ARR. If this deal crosses that, need CFO approval.
dealdesk-bot: :white_check_mark: Proposal flagged for Deal Desk review queue (ID: DD-2026-118). Auto-notify to raj_dealdesk + legal.
maria_s: Customer also asked for milestone-based SOW acceptance criteria sample. @emma_se can you share a quick snippet we can include in SOW for pilot acceptance?
emma_se: POC acceptance snippet: "Model meets latency <= 200ms p95 on provided test harness, and 95% of sampled responses pass quality gate defined in eval set." Use that and we can tie invoice to acceptance.
alex_k: Ok next steps: @raj_dealdesk to confirm approval conditions and update term sheet; @lisa_finance to confirm credit threshold + required deposit flow; @emma_se to add acceptance language; I'll coordinate procurement and get PO copy. Will escalate to CFO if ARR > $250k.
raj_dealdesk: Will update term sheet and add conditional approval language. If legal needs escrow redlines, loop them in. ETA EOD tomorrow.
lisa_finance: I'll run a quick credit check and confirm deposit path.
maria_s: Thanks all — keeping customer warm. :thumbsup:
